name: zinterp_context_print_node_tree
description: zInterp_Context::PrintNodeTree recursively logs a node name tree with two spaces of additional indentation per child level.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this recursive debug helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zInterp source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c2030 validates the null-node early return, Logf(this, "%*s%s", indent, " ", nodeName), use of zClass_NodePartial listCountB/listB at offsets 0x5c/0x60, and recursive child calls with indent + 2.
The native smoke verifies the null-node no-op and recursive log order/indent progression through a root, two children, and one grandchild.
